key_insight: eigenkit separates quantum algorithm definition from execution, enabling backend choice based on workload performance and hardware connectivity.
engineering_relevance: Provider-neutral circuits let engineers compare simulators and quantum processors without redefining algorithms for each backend.
method: Use a common circuit representation and interface across 12 execution providers.
Integrate with NumPy, PyTorch, and scikit-learn workflows.
evidence_signal: Simulator evaluations found no consistently preferable backend, while IBM Heron and IQM Emerald experiments showed that algorithm–hardware connectivity alignment affects execution quality.
watch_item: Portability does not guarantee equivalent performance or execution quality; backend capabilities and circuit topology still require evaluation.
paper_title: eigenkit: A Provider-Neutral Quantum Computing Library
